notes.title: Patch notes: V.2.0.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44248961/4504d830b2b91804344a03f256dff70cfd98a298.png[/img]

Hello, fans,

We have implemented emergency patches for the issues below.

1) Problem where the game stops at the warning page and does not proceed
2) Problem with some animations not being visible

Please update the game.

If any problems occur after the patch, please report it.

Thank you for loving Glass World.

notes.title: GLASS 2 OST release and Quiz event~!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44248961/8426dd4d2efa392d234c2572ca6a52ebf609c38c.png[/img]

Hello, GLASS fans!

New content to cool off in the hot summer! The GLASS 2 OST has been released.
The OST also contains the theme songs of the Glass Maidens that have not yet appeared.
Imagine what kind of feeling the heroines will be while listening to the theme song!

And the event you've been waiting for!!
The OST release commemorative quiz event is starting!

Comment your answer to the quiz below and we will draw 40 people and send an OST product key!

* Quiz: What is the name of the Glass Maiden who appeared in both GLASS 1 and 2?

* Event Period: 24:00 (PDT) from August 18th to August 31th, 2023

* Announcement of winners: in September 2023

We look forward to your involvement. Thank you!

notes.title: Update News (1.0.4d) : Goodbye~ Aaron!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44248961/ca8904c9382163e046d739bf2f9dfa290ee3ec14.png[/img]

In response to the opinions of everyone who loves Glass2, various updates have been made.

1. Goodbye~ Aaron!
In response to the opinion that the illustration of the male protagonist is burdensome, the graphics of Aaron, the male protagonist, have been drastically modified.
Feel free to rescue the heroines now!

2. Fix typos
Fixed the typos you reported.

3. Other updates
Adjusted the difficulty of some achievements.

4. Bug fixes
Fixed the bugs you found and reported.

We will continue to be a TSB that listens to your opinions.

Thank you.

notes.title: This is an upcoming patch.
notes.notes:
Hello, this is TSB.

Many users have commented that it is uncomfortable for the male protagonist's graphics to stand out,
We are preparing a patch to make the male protagonist less noticeable.

The exact patch date is still undecided, and we will post a notice as soon as it is completed.

Thank you for loving GLASS 2!

notes.title: Notice of scheduled update: Patch complete
notes.notes:
* Patch complete.

Hello. This is TSB.

First of all, thank you to all the users who love GLASS 2.

Currently, there are reports of problems that do not proceed normally depending on the operating system language of the PC.

We are working on a related issue and will patch it within 24 hours.

If there is a phenomenon that does not proceed on the adult content warning screen, please be patient.

Thank you very much.
